# Pet Window Expanded 1440p

## What it does

Expands the pet window to make notes more visible.
Sets default vertical size to be most of the height of a 1440p display.
Increases note character limit to 500.
Resizes and moves the buttons to avoid accidental menus in combat.

Known Issue: the buttons moved to the bottom do not reposition themselves immediately when resizing the window. Reopening the window fixes them.
